task: Build bounded read-only Cloudflare usage collection and persistent conservative reconciliation for the existing 60% allowance policy; document exact billing access and preserve safe paused activation.
nonGoals: No frontend/shared dependency edits, unrelated Cloudflare mutations, paid usage, live inference, deployments or merge. No invented freshness, completeness, metric mappings or account-wide hard-cap claims.

outcomes.description: Read-only collector uses documented account subscriptions and billable usage endpoints with bounded request/response/time limits, explicit account/subscription/period identity and sanitized results; missing permissions, incomplete data and transport failures never become zero usage.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen documented wire-shape normal, 403/429, malformed, over-limit, mismatched, partial and unknown-metric fixtures and no credential leakage tests.

outcomes.description: Persistent transactional reconciliation rejects stale, replayed, out-of-order or contradictory/decreasing cumulative measurements; distinguishes UTC AI resets, subscription rollover, storage stock and local reservations without refunds or double-credit.
outcomes.evidence: Real SQLite interleaving/contention and cycle/reset/stock/replay regressions; accepted-only evidence consumed through guarded interface, no public verified:true bypass.

outcomes.description: Collector orchestration can be run offline or explicitly read-only for access verification, exports blocked reasons and integrates with the allowance guard while production remains paused unless all trust/cost prerequisites are proven.
outcomes.evidence: End-to-end frozen transport→collector→reconciler→guard replay, stale invalidation and permission documentation.

process.description: Separate plan commit, isolated codex worktree, Terra implementation and independent review; source-bound evaluation, handoff and hosted PR CI; no deploy or unrelated changes.

Verify Billing Read needs through official Cloudflare docs/spec and sanitized read-only permission probes. No token in repository, browser, URL, traces or chat; restricted API eligibility distinct from permissions.
process.evidence: Access guide, explicit last probe and source citations.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing six-metric policy and ledger, keep collectors deterministic/bounded, avoid billing endpoint guesses or polling without a proven bootstrap allowance.

exitTest.reason: Application usage collection and reconciliation only; existing AGENTS cost/workflow policy, memory and continuation protocol remain unchanged.
